text: The agent's door: a coding agent acting for @gitdek posts through the same narrow check as `/act`. It uses its own listener, `127.0.0.1:8485`, which only his machine can reach and the tunnel never publishes, and a token the dashboard writes where only his account can read it. Browsers can't use it. Every comment it posts ends by saying a coding agent posted it for him. It exists so an agent working overnight goes through the dashboard, as he asked, instead of posting with `gh` directly. It's for his explicit instructions only, never for answering or ratifying on the agent's own initiative.
